criteria.criterion: internal/brief, internal/runs (the brief status and release reads) and the brief close command read and rewrite frontmatter only through T2's package; none keeps its own frontmatter parser.
criteria.evidence: brief/frontmatter.go uses fmpkg.Parse, runs/release.go frontmatterStatus uses frontmatter.Parse, cli/close.go uses fmpkg.Parse/Replace/SetBody; setFrontmatterStatus removed; no other "---" parsing outside internal/frontmatter

criteria.criterion: `vloop brief check` and `vloop brief list` read a ready brief saved with a BOM and CRLF endings exactly as its LF twin (same name, status, problems).
criteria.evidence: brief/check_test.go TestBOMAndCRLFBriefChecksAndListsLikeItsLFTwin compares summary and problems, and Load status

criteria.criterion: `vloop brief close` rewrites only the first line that starts with `**Status:** ready to plan` (what precedes `**Status:**` on that line is kept); a later such line and a `**Status:**` quoted mid-line are left as they were.
criteria.evidence: cli/close.go rewriteStatusLine breaks after first match; prefix class excludes mid-line quotes; test asserts 2 'ready to plan' remain

criteria.criterion: On a BOM + CRLF brief, brief close keeps the BOM and writes every line CRLF, including the run record it appends: the closed file equals the close of its LF twin with CRLF endings and the BOM.
criteria.evidence: close_test.go TestCloseCRLFBriefRewritesFirstStatusLineOnly compares byte-for-byte to the LF close converted; fm.String() writes CRLF

criteria.criterion: brief close reads the clock once: the date in the status line, the run record and any defect it records come from one time value.
criteria.evidence: close.go:125 single now := time.Now() before statusText; only time.Now call in the file

criteria.criterion: Tests cover brief check and list on a BOM + CRLF brief and brief close on a CRLF brief with two status lines and a quoted one; the checks run them.
criteria.evidence: both tests added; go check exit 0

criteria.criterion: No refactor from B12's list is folded in (one git wrapper, the env-filter copies, planSHA, driver.counts, the budget keys, the id generators, splitting long functions): a diff that does one of these fails review.
criteria.evidence: diff touches only frontmatter reads, close rewrite and the small SetBody/Lines helpers
